prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: Country learning postcard for XK in a children's world atlas.
Primary request / scene: Pristina in Kosovo, the recognisable National Library of Kosovo as the medium-distance focal point: an irregular cluster of rectilinear stone building volumes wrapped in a fine silver metal lattice, topped by many rounded white domes of different sizes. Surrounding green park, ordinary low and mid-rise Pristina city buildings and rolling hills beyond. A coherent urban landscape, no signs, letters or flags, no exaggerated mosque spires or invented castles.
Style/medium: Warm bright detailed children's travel-book illustration matching the existing atlas: soft watercolour washes, opaque gouache brushwork, fine coloured-pencil detail, tactile paper, luminous cream clouds and blue sky, gentle rich greens and teal, warm ochre and stone colours. Believable landmark and landscape geometry, lightly simplified; not photorealistic, flat vector or sticker art.
Composition: One independent full-bleed landscape, exact 3:2 ratio, 1536x1024. Clear layered foreground/midground/background, whole main landmark comfortably inside the frame and readable in a small card. Warm welcoming daylight. No collage.
Avoid: Any text, letters, signs, flags, coats of arms, logos, watermarks, frames, stamps, UI, invented landmarks or scenery from another country.
